evidence.finding: Iliad announced on 2020-12-21 that the squeeze-out would launch on 2020-12-23 at PLN 39 per share.
The notice identifies ISIN LU1642887738, acquisition effective 2020-12-23, and payment of PLN 39 per remaining share on that date.
The last source-native execution open/close is 2020-12-21; both are absent from 2020-12-22, so a frozen 2020-12-22 zero target cannot manufacture an exit fill.
Iliad reports that the remaining 3.3 percent was squeezed out at the same PLN 39 offer price and that it held all Play capital by 2020-12-31.

scope: Only the frozen expanded-period PLAY holding; no broader event inventory or total-return construction.
